name: godot
title: Godot 4 (GDScript)
applies: A Godot 4 project in the root of the repository (project.godot at the top), written in GDScript, made for the Godot version of the image, with the GUT test framework in addons/gut.

rules.rule: The project is made for the Godot version that checks it.
Every GDScript file parses without an error, with the project's classes known.
Every GDScript file is formatted as gdformat formats it.
Every GDScript file passes gdlint: naming, order of definitions, size and complexity.
Every asset imports without an error, and the .import and .uid files Godot makes for it are committed with it.
All tests under test/ pass, and the project has at least one.

enforced_by: the secret scan of the Maestro service

rules.rule: The agent cannot change these rules, the scripts that check them, the test framework, the skill, or the CI workflows.
enforced_by: the diff policy of the Maestro service (protected paths)

image:
RUN set -eu; \
    apt-get update; \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends unzip libfontconfig1 python3-venv; \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; \
    case "$TARGETARCH" in amd64) arch=x86_64 ;; arm64) arch=arm64 ;; *) echo "Godot has no build for $TARGETARCH" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; \
    base=https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable; \
    file="Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.$arch.zip"; \
    cd /tmp; \
    curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -o "$file" "$base/$file"; \
    curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -o SHA512-SUMS.txt "$base/SHA512-SUMS.txt"; \
    grep "  $file\$" SHA512-SUMS.txt | sha512sum -c -; \
    unzip -q "$file" -d /opt/godot; \
    mv "/opt/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.$arch" /opt/godot/godot; \
    ln -s /opt/godot/godot /usr/local/bin/godot; \
    rm -f "$file" SHA512-SUMS.txt; \
    python3 -m venv /opt/gdtoolkit; \
    /opt/gdtoolkit/bin/pip install --no-cache-dir --quiet gdtoolkit==4.5.0; \
    ln -s /opt/gdtoolkit/bin/gdformat /opt/gdtoolkit/bin/gdlint /usr/local/bin/
image_note: Godot 4.7.2 from its GitHub release, checked against its published checksums, and gdtoolkit 4.5.0 (about 200 MB)
after_apply: Add the GUT test framework to addons/gut if the project does not have it yet (https://github.com/bitwes/Gut), and commit it.
Run sh conventions/godot/verify.sh on your machine with GODOT pointing at Godot 4.7, and fix what it finds before switching the pack on.
